banner.saveUnavailable.body: Storage is unavailable here. Export now.
banner.saveFailed.body: The change could not be saved. The stored copy is unchanged.
banner.loadInvalid.body: Stored data did not validate: {reason}. Nothing was overwritten.
advice.unitsOnce: Makes logging stuff easier. Change at any point in Settings.
advice.timezoneDetected: Necessary for the notification bot and the week planner.
advice.timezonePick: Select from the drop down menu:
advice.timezoneInvalid: Not a recognised IANA time zone.
advice.bodyFatOptional: Optional. With it, RMR uses the Cunningham equation.
advice.bodyFatRequiredND: Required without a sex: the equation with no sex term needs it.
advice.tapeNeedsSex: Unavailable without a sex: the equations differ in form.
advice.sexDeselect: Click the selected option again to clear it.
advice.beverageRange: The reference intake is published per sex, so both figures are shown.
advice.sexWorkaround: Options suck? I agree. Click here for a workaround.
advice.tapeMethod: US Navy circumference method. Keep the tape level and snug.
advice.tapeNeedFemale: Enter neck, abdomen I and hip girths.
advice.tapeNeedMale: Enter neck and abdomen II girths.
advice.loadSteps: The smallest increment a suggested load uses. Dumbbells step per pair.
advice.deloadEveryFourth: Every fourth week halves set counts, load unchanged.
status.rateUnknown: Not established by the evidence base
advice.storedUnitsUnchanged: Stored values never change. Mass is held in kg.
label.name: How Should I Refer to You?
option.experienceIntermediate: Regular at the gym, mostly the machines
option.experienceAdvanced: Free weights for three years or more
advice.walkToGym: Do you walk to and from the gym?
advice.weighIn: Optional. Without it the 2 % fluid loss check cannot run.
advice.weighInReassurance: A number that looks bad today is one you enjoy watching move.
advice.tapeOutOfDomain: Girths outside the equation's domain. No estimate is shown.
why.bodyFatEstimate: The figure after ± is the standard error of the US Navy estimate against hydrostatic weighing. It is larger than most changes worth chasing, so track change over time rather than the absolute number.
advice.beverageDefault: Default for the stated sex: 3000 mL per day.
why.beverageDefault: IOM 2005 beverage share of the total-water adequate intake, DOI 10.17226/10925. The adequate intake for total water is 3.7 L per day for men and 2.7 L for women, of which beverages supply 3.0 L and 2.2 L. Water in food supplies the rest and is not counted here, because an app cannot measure it.
advice.intakeRejected: Daily total outside the accepted range.
advice.completeSetup: no setup, no plan. sort it out.
advice.noSessionIn14Days: nothing booked for 14 days. dry spell.
advice.deloadBlock: deload block: fewer sets, same load.
advice.beverageShortfall: beverage intake {logged} of {target} today. top it up.
why.postSessionMass: A loss above 2 % of pre-session mass means fluid replacement was inadequate (ACSM 2007).
advice.fluidLoss: Fluid loss above 2 %. Replace over the next hours.
why.fluidLoss: Loss of {loss} % of pre-session mass, above the {threshold} % threshold (ACSM 2007).
coach.loadPr: load personal record. mother. previous best {load} × {reps}.
coach.repPr: repetition personal record at {load}. mother. previous best {reps} reps.
coach.overSuggested: {delta} over the suggested load. showing off.
coach.underSuggested: {delta} under the suggested load. still counts.
coach.aboveRange: {count} reps above the prescribed range. no crumbs.
coach.belowRange: {reps} reps, below the prescribed {lo}-{hi}. it happens.

status.remindersUnsupported: This browser cannot receive push notifications.
status.remindersNeedInstall: Add this app to the Home Screen first.
status.remindersDenied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in browser site settings.
status.remindersPending: Reminders are on. Schedule not sent yet.
status.remindersNeedReenable: Reminders need enabling again on this device.
status.remindersActive: Reminders are on. Schedule last sent at {time}.
advice.jsonIsBackup: The JSON file is the complete backup.
advice.calendarAlarms: An imported alarm may not fire.
advice.importReplaces: Importing replaces everything on this device.
advice.importParseFailed: That text is not JSON. Nothing changed.
advice.fileUnreadable: The file could not be read.
advice.dataOnDevice: Everything stays on this device. No account.
advice.deleteLegacy: Removes the old app data. Anything not imported is lost.
advice.atlas: a field journal. every logged set might drop a card.
advice.timeCapsule: a note to future you, sealed until a date you pick.
status.targetsNotEstimated: Targets are not estimated for these entries. Check the body screen.
nav.label: the views
why.deloadSets: Each set count is the planned count times this block's set modifier of 0.5, rounded to the nearest whole set, minimum 1. The load is unchanged.
advice.noFormCues: No form cues for this exercise.
advice.noSessionToday: nothing assigned today. pick one on today.
advice.durationNeeded: Enter the seconds held, above zero.
advice.exportUnavailable: The data could not be read. Nothing downloaded.
advice.targetsNotEstimatedForProfile: Targets are not estimated for this profile.
advice.legacyFound: The old app has data on this device.
advice.legacyNothingDeleted: Nothing is deleted until you ask.
advice.legacyUnitRequired: Choose a unit. A wrong unit rescales every load.
advice.legacyRefused: The old data could not be read. Nothing changed.
advice.legacyApplyFailed: The import was refused. Nothing changed.
advice.legacyStored: The import is stored. The old data is untouched.
advice.legacyStoreUnconfirmed: The write was not confirmed. The old data stays.
advice.legacyOldDataDeleted: The old app data is deleted.
advice.legacyOldDataKept: The old app data was kept.
disclosure.legacyTransfers: Logged sets, weekly push-up maxima, body-mass check-ins, beverage intake, daily notes, collected specimen cards, and a sealed time capsule. Anything the import cannot read is listed with its reason first.
disclosure.legacyBodyMassEvidence: The old body-mass field was labelled lb, refused values outside the pound range, and its text export reported pounds. The load field carried no such evidence, so that unit is asked for.
label.legacyLoadUnit: Load Unit in the Old App
label.legacyBodyMassUnit: Body Mass Unit in the Old App
advice.reminderSubscribeFailed: The browser refused to register this device.
advice.reminderSyncFailed: The schedule did not reach the server.
advice.installOnlyInstalledApp: Only an installed app receives notifications.
status.installIosShare: Tap Share, the square with an upward arrow.
status.installIosAdd: Scroll down, tap Add to Home Screen, then tap Add.
status.installIosOpen: Open the app from the Home Screen icon.
status.installAndroidMenu: Open the browser menu, the three dots.
status.installAndroidOpen: Open the app from the home screen icon.
coach.aboveRangeOne: {count} rep above the prescribed range. no crumbs.
status.customExerciseRefused: nope. the exercise was not added.

status.refusalSessionOpen: A session is already in progress on {date}.
status.refusalNotNextDay: {date} is not the next session day.
status.motivationClipNone: No clip chosen. The bundled clip plays.
advice.motivationClipStorage: Stored on this device, never uploaded.
advice.motivationClipLimit: The limit is {bytes} bytes. MiB means {mib} bytes. A clip of 25 MiB or less plays back reliably on a phone.
status.motivationClipNotVideo: That file is not a video.
status.motivationClipTooLarge: That file is over the size limit.
advice.capsuleDefaultMoved: The suggested date moved into the allowed range.
status.konami: no cheat code. nobody skips a squat.
advice.wipeRemoves: Removes every profile, plan, session, set and note on this device.
advice.skinChanges: A skin changes wording and colour, never numbers or units.
advice.clipClearFailed: The clip was not removed. Everything else was deleted.
advice.interventionBody: the week flopped, not you. the next slot still stands.
advice.hotkeysOff: Off leaves Escape and the modifier shortcuts bound.
advice.setupInstruction: Answer each step. Nothing leaves this device.
advice.todayInstruction: Start, resume, or skip the session assigned today.
advice.planInstruction: Browse blocks and weeks, then open any session card.
advice.trainInstruction: Log sets, rest between them, and finish the session.
advice.targetsInstruction: Review daily energy, protein, fluid and creatine targets.
advice.logInstruction: Browse body mass, compliance, best reps and personal records.
advice.atlasInstruction: Browse cards unlocked by the sets you have logged.
advice.settingsInstruction: Adjust units, reminders, skin, sounds, and manage your data.
advice.timezoneGrouped: Zones with identical offsets all year are grouped; search finds all.
advice.timezoneDayBoundary: Every date and weekly close is computed in this zone.
advice.timezoneReminders: Turn them on and the gym bag stops staying at home.
advice.goalOutcomeFatLoss: Lose fat and keep the muscle you already have.
advice.goalOutcomeMuscleGain: Build muscle, and accept some fat gain alongside it.
advice.goalOutcomeRecomposition: Lose fat and build muscle at the same time.
advice.goalOutcomeMaintenance: Hold your body composition and build better training habits.
advice.goalRecompositionCost: Energy is held at maintenance for this goal. The content review does not cover recomposition, so holding maintenance energy introduces no coefficient the report does not supply, and the protein range is an extrapolation from the muscle-gain row rather than a figure the review states.
advice.targetBodyFatUnavailable: No body-fat estimate yet, so the target is body mass.
advice.targetBodyFatBasis: The fat mass and lean mass shown assume lean mass is held while fat is lost, which is what the prescribed rate targets. A tape estimate carries a standard error of {see} percentage points of body fat, so read the target as a direction rather than as a number to hit.
advice.impliedComposition: At that target: {fat} fat mass and {lean} lean mass.
advice.feasibilityEstimate: An estimate from a prescribed rate, not a prediction about you.
advice.feasibilityRate: That date needs about {rate} of body mass per week.
advice.feasibilitySlow: Slower than the prescribed rate, and realistic.
advice.feasibilityNoWeeklyRate: No established weekly rate exists for muscle gain.
advice.feasibilityMassHeld: This goal holds body mass, so no weekly rate applies.
advice.feasibilityNeedsTarget: Set a target above before these dates can be judged.
advice.feasibilityNeedsFuture: Pick a date after today before this can be judged.
advice.feasibilityNotALoss: That target is not below your current body mass.
status.sessionEditRefused: Change not saved. Reload to see the current session.
advice.programmeDiffers: These settings would build a different programme.
advice.programmeRestart: Starts a new programme today. Logged sets, records and body mass stay.
advice.programmeLockedInSession: Finish or skip the session in progress first.
advice.targetReachedMaintenance: Target body mass reached, so the next programme defaults to maintenance.
